name: Battleborn
body:
The battlefield calms your mind and hones your spirit.

Prerequisite(s): Base Attack Bonus +3 or Wis 13+, Iron Will.

Benefit(s): When in combat you gain a +2 bonus on saves against all mind-affecting or emotion spells and effects, in addition the DC of any demoralize attempt made against you has its DC increased by 4.
